items.title: Building an Internal Developer Platform with Artificial Intelligence
items.summaryShort: Building an Internal Developer Platform with Artificial Intelligence. Agents are becoming the new developer platform, using semantic search with data from tools like Git, Slack, and Jira for context.

items.title: Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Project Karmada Reaches CNCF Graduation
items.summaryShort: Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Project Karmada Reaches CNCF Graduation. The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) announced on September 2026 that Karmada, a multi-cluster and multi-cloud Kubernetes orchestration project, has graduated.

items.title: Presentation: When Incidents Refuse to End
items.summaryShort: Presentation: When Incidents Refuse to End. Vanessa Huerta Granda explains how marathon incidents expose the gap between work as imagined and work as done.

items.title: Repeated VM Escapes By GPT-5.6-Cyber Based Agents Prove VMs and OS' Require Better Maintenance
items.summaryShort: Repeated VM Escapes By GPT-5.6-Cyber Based Agents Prove VMs and OS' Require Better Maintenance. Traditional virtual machines are inadequate for isolating cyber-capable autonomous agents.

items.title: TanStack Charts Introduced with a Framework Agnostic Grammar of Graphics for TypeScript
items.summaryShort: TanStack Charts Introduced with a Framework Agnostic Grammar of Graphics for TypeScript. TanStack Charts is a new, framework-agnostic visualization library for TypeScript.

items.title: Khosla-backed Mazama Energy just raised $135M to drill deeper into super-hot-rock geothermal
items.summaryShort: Khosla-backed Mazama Energy just raised $135M to drill deeper into super-hot-rock geothermal. Geothermal startup Mazama is drilling three miles underground to tap superhot rock, with one well capable of generating 15 MW of electricity 24/7.

items.title: Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories'
items.summaryShort: Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories'. The round values the data center giant at $30.9 billion.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
items.summaryShort: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate. The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI.
